title: MATH 3042 Statistics · Midterm
subtitle: Wednesday Oct 28, 3:00 pm, SW5-1840, 90 minutes, paper and calculator: Units 1 to 4, with R commands written by hand
description: Everything for the midterm in one place: the study order through the four unit modules, then the practice midterm worked question by question in the instructor's own rounding and wording, R on paper (the d, p, q and r families, turning an inequality into a p-function, writing a simulation function) from Labs 6 and 7, the three things the unit modules never teach (expected value in dollars, the variance shortcut on the formula sheet, Poisson across separate intervals), the sixteen Unit 4 practice problems worked, two mock midterms in the real 12-question, 46-mark format, and a one-page split of what the provided formula sheet gives you versus what you must know cold.
intro:
:::quiz Midterm facts
**Wednesday Oct 28 2026, 3:00 pm, room SW5-1840, 90 minutes.** Paper and pencil plus a scientific calculator with statistics functions; no computer. **Units 1 to 4, everything up to the Poisson distribution** (Unit 5 is out). R is on the exam: "write an R command that does XYZ". Worth **30 %** of the course. A **formula sheet and an R sheet are provided**; you cannot bring your own. The practice paper is 12 questions, 46 marks: about 10 marks of R commands, about 13 of written interpretation (a histogram, a summary table, side-by-side boxplots), the rest calculation. Rounding rule on the cover: a probability to four decimal places, anything else to three significant digits.
:::
